scope: Evaluation only; no connector added to CAD, PCB, released BOM or wiring
preferred_architecture: One keyed locking inline 10-circuit crimp connector between matrix and controller; preserve PCB and GPIO

primary_candidate.existing_wire_restriction: 26AWG insulation OD must be 1.2 to 1.3mm to satisfy connector and existing wire routing simultaneously
primary_candidate.rating_note: 3A maximum family rating; not an allowed product load or permission to hot plug
primary_candidate.procurement_state: Proposal only, housing stock risk; no order

alternatives.name: Two 5-circuit JST SM pairs
alternatives.reason: Both housing sides observed stocked; separate rows and columns/power
risks: Two interchangeable identical 5P plugs can be confused; reverse housing genders or add distinct physical keying before adoption
Requires two exact placements and wire service paths; not verified

alternatives.name: CJT A1257H-10P / A1257WR-S-10P board-to-wire 1.25mm family
risks: Requires new PCB footprint and release; existing J1-J10 are separated solder points, not a header footprint
A1257-TP terminal supports 28-32AWG and insulation OD at most 1mm; existing 26AWG is incompatible
Not recommended as a drop-in change

alternatives.name: CJT A1256H-10P / C339021
alternatives.decision: Do not confuse with inline pair; board-to-wire family, not directly a flying male/female cable connector

space_probe.type: Temporary rectangular clearance probe, not CAD geometry or exact connector model
space_probe.interpretation: Nominal static space only, very little tolerance height. Does not reserve occupied flexible wire loops or validate latch travel, finger access, wire exit/bend, actual molding dimensions, strain relief or extraction.

service_sequence: Support bottom cover, remove four M3 screws, lower no more than validated 30mm
Release connector latch while holding both housings, never pull wires
Separate cover with controller and LCD; reconnect by marked cavity numbers and perform unpowered checks
mandatory_before_implementation: Acquire exact connector CAD or dimensioned tolerances and validate fully mated body plus latch
Design retention and reroute left matrix spare wire zone, do not stack wire loop under connector
Preserve at least 65mm free wire service span excluding connector body; verify actual pigtail lengths
Check end-to-end mapping, no reverse cavity numbering or reliance on cable colors; live plugging prohibited
